reason: We have the zoo, storytime and the parks, and they're all free, so paying $13 a visit just doesn't fit how I do things. I might swing by for the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay after that.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and I'd be paying every time for something the zoo and library give us for free.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or a few dollars on weekday mornings, or if my toddler would actually stay in the Baby Nook so I could sit.
